hooks.text: 逐室找钥匙深入地牢冲击高分
hooks.excerpt: Find the key in each room to advance. Level up. Acquire weapons, shields, blessings, and potions to alter your character. Achieve a high score based on the room number you reach.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 房间敌人物品规则每局重组
hooks.excerpt: Rooms, enemies, items, and modifiers are procedurally generated every run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 本地同屏与在线四人共闯地牢
hooks.excerpt: Couch Co-op (local shared screen, up to 4 players) Online Co-op (up to 4 players per game)
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: This thing crashes every 30 minutes or so.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器看似多样，但实际种类比前作更少。

excerpts.excerpt: 武器看起来种类繁多，但实际上2代的武器种类居然远远少于1代。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 装备获取过度依赖运气。

excerpts.excerpt: 装备的获取和运气成分过大
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: still needs a lot of work in stability and balancing with the weapons
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器平衡仍需大量改进。

excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器额外冲击感让连招手感很好。

excerpts.excerpt: almost all weapons have an extra punch that makes your combos feel extremely good
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 没有局外成长，依靠玩家自身进步的设计令人耳目一新。

excerpts.excerpt: [b]There’s no meta-progression[/b], which is very refreshing
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 死亡通常源于玩家自身失误，而非随机或廉价死亡。

opinions.text: 操控自由且游戏轻松爽快。

excerpts.excerpt: 优点是操控自由，游戏很轻松，爽快爆瓜
